market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from 10Y >5%, Fed hike expectations, and falling consumer sentiment. Oil volatility from Iran/Hormuz adds noise. Equities likely range-bound with sector rotation favoring energy, defense, and AI infrastructure over consumer discretionary and housing. European stocks may outperform on relative value. Bond market remains the dominant macro driver.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (Nvidia, AMD, Micron, Palantir, Salesforce) supports 12-month equity upside if earnings deliver. US-China 2-month truce provides temporary tariff relief but structural decoupling continues. Housing correction in US/Australia may deepen. Social Security fiscal risk is a slow-burn issue. Defense and industrial capex cycles offer multiyear visibility. Energy transition policy pressure (fossil fuel subsidy debate) creates long-term headwinds for incumbents.
